name: Associate Degree Nursing (A45110)
sourceWorkbook: Southeastern CC: ADN and LPN-to-ADN admission pages, the Nursing program page, the campus facilities list, the 2026–27 academic calendar, the NC Board of Nursing 2024 approved-programs list (max enrollment 140) and 2021–2023 pass rates; course hours, credits and sequence from the NCCCS A45110 standard — compiled 2026-10-28
maxCohortNote: Class size 70, derived at the owner's request (2026-10-28) from the NC Board of Nursing's approved maximum enrollment of 140 for the ADN program (2024 list): the cap covers both levels, so a fall class of 70 leaves 70 second-year seats for the continuing students and the LPN-to-ADN cohort; the Board allows up to ten over. The college publishes no class size.
weeklyHoursNote: Term hours per student are the catalog's weekly contact hours × 16 (the 16-week basis), whatever the term's length: the sessions carry them, the posted days, times and rooms place them. Hours and credits are the NCCCS course standard's; no section days, times or rooms are published, so every session carries its hours with no day or time; the summer term is the college's 10-week session (May 17 – Jul 27, 2027).

courses.title: Introduction to Health Concepts
courses.requisites: Admission to the program; NUR 117 Pharmacology within five years
courses.description: Introduces the concepts within the three domains of the individual, healthcare and nursing: medication administration, assessment, nutrition, ethics, interdisciplinary teams, informatics, evidence-based practice, individual-centered care and quality improvement. Clinical: long-term care in the first eight weeks, adult medical-surgical in the second (the standard's usual placement). Hours and credits are the NCCCS standard's; the term placement is the standard's A45110 sequence — not yet confirmed against the college's catalog (unreachable 2026-10-28).
